reviews.author: Jonathan Latour
reviews.text: The only shop we trust, for everything. We've been bringing both our company fleet and personal vehicles to RJ Automotive for some time now, and I can say without hesitation that they are the best shop we've ever worked with. Whether it's routine oil changes and tire rotations, brake jobs, electrical diagnostics, engine work, transmission repair or anything else a vehicle might need, they handle it all with the same level of skill and care. There is truly nothing they can't do. What sets RJ Automotive apart isn't just their technical ability, it's how they operate. They're fast without cutting corners, professional in every interaction, and they actually communicate with you throughout the process. You're never left wondering what's going on with your vehicle. They explain the work clearly, give you honest assessments, and follow through on exactly what they say they'll do. Managing a fleet of vehicles is no small task, and having a shop we can rely on has made a real difference for our business. They keep our company vehicles running efficiently and minimize downtime, which matters. And on the personal side, we feel just as well taken care of, they treat every vehicle like it's their own. If you're looking for a shop that combines real expertise, speed, and genuine professionalism, RJ Automotive is it.

reviews.author: Donald Bee
reviews.text: My sister-in-law needed several repairs done to her car. It was previously worked on by another auto repair, with disappointing results. There was still much more that needed corrected, and the car was still smoking from the oil leak that was paid to be fixed. After having her car for 12 days, we did not want to trust their work again. RJ auto repair was recommended to us, and after a brief examination Randy gave us a detailed plan for the repair, which included correctly fixing the other shop's work. She received her car back in one day & it is working great. We highly recommend RJ Auto Repair with confidence. You will not be disappointed

reviews.author: Dwight Davis
reviews.text: My sister had a lot of work done at a different garage in town recently. The engine was left covered in oil and grease so bad it smoked continuously and you couldn’t tell if it had been fixed. She visited this shop suggested by my brother Jeff, and they pressure washed the engine, reviewed her earlier repair, and didn’t even charge her for the service. As far as I’m concerned she’s finally found a car repair facility that we can trust and any future work we need to have done will come here.

reviews.author: Stephanie Barnette-Holopainen
reviews.text: I have taken my car there twice now. For radiator issues and the shop is very knowledgeable about the repair. R J automotive provided quick turnaround!

reviews.author: Thomas Counavelis
reviews.text: The folks at RJ Automotive were awesome!!! We brought our truck there to have door handles installed on both doors since one of the doors handles was broken. They went above and beyond what was asked to repair the door handles. Thanks especially go out to the technician who had to deal with this issue. We would highly recommend RJ Automotive to anyone!!!

reviews.author: Edward Betts
reviews.text: I very rarely do this but I had to let people know about the hidden jewel in Burlington, NC. About 3 weeks ago in late February. I had some major work done on my truck. I didn't know who would perform the custom work without going to the dealer being it was a diesel truck. RJ Automotive was recommended to me from Rudy's Custom shop. Jason at Rudy's recommended RJ Automotive for the install. Needless to say, I'm beyond impressed.The crew at RJ Automotive exceeded my expectations. They were knowledgeable and very professional through the entire process. Randy,the owner/operator, kept me informed on his progress and fixed potential issues that may have arose in the future. Through text and pics he kept me well informed. If you need a good if not excellent mechanic in all aspect in the automotive field. Please don't give it a second thought about this establishment. They do it all from major work to minor things like oil changes, batteries, or tire rotations. You definitely wont be disappointed. He has a great crew working for him. Most importantly his prices for services are more than reasonable. Needless to say, he definitely has a future customer for my any and every need, Thank you RJ Automotive. IF every shop was as reliable and trustworthy as you the world would be a different place. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Jacob Click
reviews.text: My wife and I have taken our vehicles to RJs exclusively since we have been in Burlington. Their Service is always Top Tier. They are courteous and professional, turnaround time has always been excellent, and their work is second to none. We will continue to seek them out for their valuable expertise when it comes to servicing our vehicles.

reviews.author: David Jackson
reviews.text: I'm traveling with a loaded pickup and trailer in tow and had a breakdown last evening, but if I lived in the area, THIS would be my shop. Randy and Jennifer (the RJ in RJ Automotive, a family-owned and -run business) have developed a great service business and I benefited greatly from their efforts. After some research and parking lot diagnosing myself last night, I realized the issue that had developed with my older pickup will require additional work when I get to my destination, and I had a plan for what I would like done to get me back on the road so I could deliver before rain approaches. When I called this morning, I knew right away that Randy knows what he's talking about, so I headed to his shop. As busy as they were this morning, seeing that I was traveling, he listened to my observations graciously, and was able to fit me into the schedule, without making me feel like he was being put out or stressed. He even came up with a second potential option for getting me back on the road more quickly, which after foreman Chris pulled the truck apart, turned out to be the best option, and the one I chose, saving me time and money. I was so grateful. I appreciated being offered the chance to see the damaged parts and to see the finished job and how well it was now working. Jennifer kept the front office humming along and it was a pleasure to listen in on how all customers are treated the same way I had been treated. I was treated with respect all the way through, kept informed, and made to feel welcome. The replacement part arrived fast, was installed fast, and between Randy, Chris, and Jennifer, I was well cared for. Thank you for being so helpful, professional, friendly, and all at a fair price. I could not have asked for a better place to break down in or a better team to work with.

reviews.author: Greenway Nest
reviews.text: This place and the people are AWESOME! They were recommended to me to have work done on my car because I needed a catalytic converter. I was going to the beach the next weekend. Randy was such a nice guy and told me not to worry about anything. He asked if I could bring my car the next morning and he would get it ready for the beach. That is exactly what he did! I then had a knob break that controls the fan speed for my heating/air and he took care of that as well. His wife Jenny was very helpful with that situation as well. This is where I will take my car anytime it needs something done and I highly recommend them!!!!

reviews.author: John Best
reviews.text: Randy got my 1998 k1500 back on the road. All new front end. He even fixed a few electrical issues that had me stumped. Can’t thank them enough for all their hard work. Hard to find honest mechanics that will take the time to help with older trucks.

reviews.author: Kevin Ingerick
reviews.text: Staff and mechanics were professional and fast. Got all 3 of my cars in and out without delay and affordable. He was even able to do work on my 72' Chevelle! Those guys can work on anything!

reviews.author: Mercedes Gonzalez
reviews.text: I took my daughter’s car to RJ's auto shop for repairs, and from the moment I inquired about a diagnostic check, the experience was outstanding. The communication throughout the entire process with Randy and Jenn, was impeccable. I honestly haven’t seen this level of professionalism in a long time; I almost thought it no longer existed. Jenn clearly explained everything that was going on, what was most important to address, and never made me feel pressured or confused. Most importantly, I felt I could truly trust them. I’m comfortable sending my daughter here on her own in the future, knowing they would be honest with her and not try to take advantage. That peace of mind means everything. Highly recommend this shop.

reviews.author: Rabbit
reviews.text: Im from out of town and my ac stopped working... called them up dropped it off and was done in less then 2hrs and left me tons of time to get to enjoy vacation. Definitely recommend

reviews.author: jennifer street
reviews.text: Shout out to Randy and his guys at RJ Automotive for hooking up my Gladiator with a lift and 35/12.50 20’s. Fast,affordable and as always great work. No cutting corners with these guys. If you need anything done to one of your vehicles from maintenance to upgrades go see Randy.

reviews.author: J Grinnell
reviews.text: A deer hit my truck and a friend of mine referred me here . Randy and his guys were awesome. He explains what’s happening and handled everything so I didn’t need to take it to a body shop after the repairs. Nice guy and he is highly recommended . I hope I won’t have to come back but if so I’ll come back here.

reviews.author: Jim Smith
reviews.text: RJ Automotive was recommended to me by a friend and I was very pleased with the service I received. I’ve found my new “go to” for all my automotive service needs!

reviews.author: Paul Graham
reviews.text: My Audi was getting a complex because practically every garage flatly refused to work on it. German cars are too difficult for those who are used to Domestic brands, it seems. Not so for Randy and the team. Thermostat fitted and windscreen washers working for the first time in a long time in a long time. When I have some cash to spare in 2023 I am taking it back to get more things fixed! Great job guys. You delivered.

reviews.author: Dustin McGowan
reviews.text: Great shop owned by a friend got my lift and my tires for my truck there. They lifted my truck with no issues rides like I’m on a cloud. Great customer service fair prices I will always do business there. Go check him out Randy knows what he doing also had my wife’s SRT Durango worked on there she loves the work has ZERO issues. The only place I trust.

reviews.author: M. McKines
reviews.text: Great service! Very professional! I appreciated the ongoing updates and communication regarding the repairs and process.

reviews.author: ryan walker
reviews.text: Rj Automotive has rebuilt my transition in my truck and put a new engine in my car. Both were fair prices and done in an extremely professional and timely manner. Randy and everyone else are friendly and knowledgeable. I would highly recommend Rj automotive for all your car needs you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Austin Madden
reviews.text: Know the people and owner well. Have took my car there for several services and always got amazing work done and recommendations for anything else needed. No issues and nice and friendly and help out anyway they can. thank you RJ automotive

reviews.author: Lou Marinaro
reviews.text: Via recommendation from a competitor, needed the rear brakes done on our 2018 Equinox. Got done pretty quick even when needing to order a couple rotors. Unfortunately costs were a bit high but I didn't care, I got quality service from a reliable tech (thank Chris B). I will use their services in the future.

reviews.author: Nick Stratton
reviews.text: I was originally recommended to go here by several mechanic shops that were scared of the electrical issue I had with my van (squirrels). They told me to tow it to RJ Auto, and they would know what to do (which was great advice). They are competent, friendly, fast, and I haven't felt like unnecessary services have been pushed on me, so far. Confident 5 stars!

reviews.author: Blake Cain
reviews.text: Great service, reasonable prices, and wonderful staff. Everyone there treated me with kindness and respect. The communication directly between the mechanic and myself was a huge help. They were quick and efficient once the parts came in. All in all I was satisfied with the work at RJ Automotive. Would definitely recommend giving them a call.

reviews.author: •Yessica Gisselle Âme•
reviews.text: They do a decent job. The Staff at the front counter are very friendly and helpful. BUT There is ONE thing I have to say, the mechanic KNEW that my car had something else that needed to be fix to RUN Smoothly and decided not to let me know. I know this because the mechanic told me when I called them about this issue. I don’t know NOTHING about cars, when I take my cars to the mechanic I trust them to be honest. If they would’ve told me about that other issue on my car I wouldn’t have spend the money that I Spent to fix it, but they told me that my car would be fixed and running Smoothly once I fixed that issue and I trusted them.

reviews.author: Brandy Hefner
reviews.text: I recently had my 2015 Jeep Cherokee Towed to RJ Automotive because it was popping and grinding real bad. I had several people recommend me to them. Same day I spoke with Randy and he told me what was going on with my car and that I needed a new front Ptu I believe that's what he called it.but went over cost and labor and prices were fair.. it took about 4 days and received a call from randy again saying my Jeep was ready. Let's just say I'm so happy to have my jeep back and driving smoother then ever. Thank you Randy @ RJ Automotive for taking care of me. I'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Karin Yates
reviews.text: These are the nastiest people I have ever dealt with! They charged a diagnostic fee that was supposed to be credited once the work was done and then tried to tell me it was expired (!!!) The owners were arguing and yelling at me! They finally relented and after I paid the not-cheap bill the problem wasn’t fixed. They didn’t test drive it after or make sure the engine light was off. They tried to tell me they test drove it and was fine but I saw them not do that . Horribly dishonest people and once they do the work that I paid them to do I will NEVER go back or recommend to others!

reviews.author: Casey Clayton
reviews.text: Randy knows his stuff. My family and I trust his expertise when it comes to our vehicles. There is no one else in Alamance county we'd trust our vehicles to completely. Kaylee at the front desk is professional, polite, and courteous and able to answer what questions we have. RJ automotive is an A+ and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Alex Clapp
reviews.text: Wonderful family owned company. Very sharp on their skills, quick, and reasonably priced. But most importantly they are trust worthy people. I have always been weary of taking my vehicles to a shop but after finding RJ’s I have full confidence in their skills and work ethic. Thank you to Randy and every person working in the shop for always providing excellent service!

reviews.author: Kayla Jackson
reviews.text: EDIT TO OWNERS RESPONSE: Yes my car and my fiancés car has been there many times, just different Gmail name. I’ve posted a receipt for your proof so we’re not called a liar by you once again. Also attached the screenshot of the phone call from today where my fiance was talking to Cailey about our concerns. The owners response to this review and other negative reviews is the perfect example of how they will dismiss your concerns and lie, when they know we just talked to them about this issue today! Also immediately after posting this negative review they had random people flood the ratings with good reviews. Shady as could be! Terribly dishonest people who will not stand behind their work. Dropped off a perfectly fine key fob and picked it up broken and put together with missing buttons ($300+ fix). When asked they were immediately aggressive and argumentative and said they didn’t break the fob, then tried saying that it was broken when we gave it to them (it wasn’t), then said that the key is 14 years old and could have snapped apart when they were working on it and it’s not their fault (it didn’t per the experts fixing the fob, they said it looked like someone stepping on it and cracked it), then said they could have dropped it all in the same phone call. On top of that, we got a brand new battery in the car per their recommendation and the next night the car started sparking/dying. When we also brought up those concerns they immediately dismissed our concerns saying it can’t be anything they did and that they would charge us for another diagnostic. Weeks after my fiancés car shut off while doing 70mph on the highway, turns out it wasn’t the battery they charged us almost $400 for, the connection to the battery was terribly corroded which they should have known was the cause and would have seen while replacing the battery. Almost cost us a new battery that auto zone was luckily able to catch and help us for $12! Could have cost my fiance his life because of their negligence. Don’t believe these few good reviews they will be perfectly nice the first couple times before you have any actual concern with the quality of work being done, then they will immediately be aggressive, rude, and dismissive to your concerns.

reviews.author: Robert Edwards
reviews.text: They take care of you at the place! I have a BMW that two shops were unable to fix, both telling me that it had to be taken to a BMW dealership. Randy was able to fix the issues without any problems. They work on all vehicles, and after a conversation with Randy, I didn't buy a car that he said would cause me issues in the future. Above and beyond what a typical shop does every time! Caleigh provides updates before any work is done!. The Staff is very responsive and professional. Very prompt service!

reviews.author: David F
reviews.text: I have had Randy work on several of my personal vehicles. He has always been very informative and transparent about what he has to do and treats your vehicle repairs as if it were his own vehicle or his family driving them. Recently took a family member's handicap van to him for evaluation and repair, about a week before Christmas. Randy got on it super fast and was able to get it repaired right before Christmas, so that my family member would be able to get out for family gatherings. He called and gave me a detailed explanation for the repairs needed, before completion, with an estimated cost. No surprises when I went to pick the vehicle up. Randy is a super nice, respectful guy and his staff have always been great to work with. Its hard to find a good, honest, dependable and reasonably priced mechanic it seems. I will definitely be using Randy's business for future mechanical repairs. Thanks again RJ Automotive!!!!

reviews.author: Seanessee West
reviews.text: I wanted a diagnosis on my suburban as I was having fuel issues and RJ automotive helped me figure that out. They are very nice and patient people and even though I did not get the truck repaired with them they made it easy for me to retrieve my vehicle offering after hour pick up options and were very kind and pleasant to deal with all around. I would recommend anyone with car troubles to give them a try to get those issues resolved.

reviews.author: Darrell Black
reviews.text: Best service I ever had had a transmission replaced in three days. Everybody around there was very polite. Couldn’t ask for a better place. Work was excellent.

reviews.author: Charles Beasley
reviews.text: Excellent shop. Have taken multiple vehicles to them over the last year. They are always fast, and always back their work. Best shop I've used since moving here. Update to my previous review: I cannot reinforce how great Randy, Jenn, and the RJ team have treated my family and our various rides. Always on time, up front, and always go the extra mile for us.

reviews.author: Ciaira Bernard
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about RJS Automotive! From start to finish, the team was incredibly professional, reliable, and efficient. They worked on our vehicle quickly without compromising quality, and the entire process was seamless. Their communication was amazing, they kept my husband updated every step of the way and made sure we fully understood what was being done to our car. It’s clear they genuinely care about their customers and take pride in their work. We were recommend to RJs by a buddy at Thrive Church. We have heard nothing but great things about RJs so we went forward. Even the tow truck driver confirmed that he takes vehicles all the time to RJs and he had nothing but praises for the shop as well. We see why!! We will absolutely continue to bring our vehicle here in the future and highly recommend RJS Automotive to anyone looking for top-notch service. If you want a trustworthy and skilled team working on your car, this is the place to go! Thanks Y’all! Stay Blessed!

reviews.author: Ashley Sasser
reviews.text: Excellent service!!! I cannot say enough good things about RJ Automotive. It’s refreshing to walk into a family-owned business that practices good old-fashioned values. Everyone is so professional, welcoming, and accommodating. Quality and efficient service/workmanship you can trust at a reasonable price point.

reviews.author: Michael Wilburn
reviews.text: This shop has worked on several of my company vehicles. They alway do a great job and are very professional. I have had two transmission and several other mechanical issue. From small to large problems they can handle it all. The staff is always informative and works hard to keep you up to date on the work. I have used several mechanic in my life and grew up around my families service station as a kid. This is a great place with caring people. I appreciate them and am very thankful for the work they do.

reviews.author: Rebecca Halfacre
reviews.text: RJ Automotive does amazing work! They keep our vehicles running whether it be oil changes, modifications, diesel work, regular maintenance, etc. It's family owned and operated and we love supporting local businesses. The staff is friendly, and knowledgeable and they offer great customer service. Randy and his wife are always a pleasure to chat with!

reviews.author: Superior Roofing & Gutters
reviews.text: Randy & Jen are absolutely amazing! If you’re looking for an auto repair shop in Alamance county - RJ Automotive is it! They’ve worked on our company & family vehicles and their work is superior to any other shop around. They’re honest & stand behind their work! We will always recommend them to everyone we know.

reviews.author: Mary Forbis
reviews.text: I chose this shop because of the great reviews it had and I'm glad I did. My ac is working great now and so is my brakes. Thank you for the great job yall did on my car. For anyone looking for a place to get yr call worked on, this is the place to go to. "Tid bit" No matter what shop you go to, yr going to pay money for the work. So for those of you that complain about the price of work done to yr vehicles. Just remember nothing is cheap anymore, so if you have to have yr vehicle worked on, wouldn't you want it done right. I don't have a mechanical degree, and there is going to be times when I need work done on my car. This place is now my go to for mechanical work.

reviews.author: Amanda E.
reviews.text: Fast, reliable service. I needed a bunch of repairs done on my Mini Cooper before a big trip. They had it finished in 3 days. Everyone in the shop is knowledgeable and friendly. Compared to other auto shops in the area, RJ Automotive was definitely the easiest on my wallet. I will be taking my car here from now on without hesitation.

reviews.author: Ronnie Lambert
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company. I have learned first hand that this is a honest stand up company run with integrity. I feel very comfortable saying you can trust this company to look out for your best interest just as they did for me and I had no past experience with them. They will have all my future business!

reviews.author: McPherson Brown
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of having my 76 El-Camino worked by Randy (the Owner) and his team. They diagnosed and overhauled my transmission in no time at all at an affordable price. Randy is very knowledgeable and polite as he took the time to deeply explain what was going on. I would 1000% percent recommend this shop for any of your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Shave Bennett
reviews.text: Went in to speak about doing some routine maintenance to my 2015 F150 4x4 and had the pleasure of speaking with Randy. I had some specific requests that he and his staff were more than happy to accommodate. Plus, the personable attitude and openness to discuss his experiences as a mechanic led me to believe he genuinely takes pride in his work and enjoys running an honest repair shop. All told, the work was done and I am extremely satisfied with the work. Prices were honest and reasonable for the work done. They do charge a 3% fee on credit/debit card transactions so bring cash or venmo, applepay, etc. I look forward to bringing my other vehicles to his shop for the things I am unable to do on my own. Thanks Randy, to you and your team! Good job!

reviews.author: Bryan G
reviews.text: These guys are absolutely amazing! After being broke down for over a week at the dealership, they had be back rolling in a week with a brand new rebuilt transmission! Price was unbelievable! I would highly recommend them. They will certainly be getting all of my business!!

reviews.author: Bob Campbell
reviews.text: Took my 05 Grand Cherokee 5.7 for a bad ticking in the engine and transmission shifting issue. Randy called me the next day and gave me a very good detailed explanation on what's going on. With in a week had my car back and it sounds a lot better and transmission shifts great. Thanks for getting me in and getting my car done fast. People there are very respectful and sound like they really do care about there customers. Thanks RJ AUTOMOTIVE for taking care of me. I will be back again

reviews.author: Melissa Ward
reviews.text: I have trusted and recommend Randy and his team for many years. They are professional and fair. My mother and mother-in -law (both elderly), and anyone else I have referred, have been treated very well. Randy has worked on all of our cars over the years, and has even stayed late to get them ready. My husband and I have followed Randy wherever he has worked. He always takes the time to explain the problem, how to fix it, and the costs involved. For one of the fellow teachers we referred, Randy found a mistake from another mechanic at another shop that could have catastrophic. We will always always be a fan of RJ automotive.

reviews.author: Gary Uther
reviews.text: Randy and his crew are top notch. I have never had a mechanic communicate with me as much as Randy. Professionalism, honesty, trust, and prompt service are all to be norm for this business. Cost is fair and they won't do anything without your permission. They are also specialist in Dodge Ram and Jeep vehicles among others. Do yourself a favor the next time you need automotive work done on your vehicle. Take it to RJ Automotive in Burlington.

reviews.author: alamance reserve
reviews.text: RJ Automotive Is A Great Place To Take Or Tow Your Vehicle That Needs Any Kind Of Service/Repair Done. They Came Highly Recommended By Many People & They Did Not Disappoint When Staff Had To Call Them. Thank You RJ Automotive. Looking Forward To Sending Many More People Y’all’s Way. We Appreciate All Yall Do For The Community. Thank You For Your Hard, Honest Work & Dedication.

reviews.author: Craig Smith
reviews.text: Really kind and accommodating team. I've only had one repair done through them thus far, but I can tell they have a lot of passion and drive (no pun intended) for what they do. Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Kat Freeland
reviews.text: I would give a 10 if possible! Very honest and nice people! Took my car to 4 other places and they could not help me with getting a tire off due to key lock being broken. These guys fixed me up the same day and did what no one else could! I will be going here for all my mechanic needs from now on! Hard to find honest people these days.

reviews.author: Lia Dixon
reviews.text: This place is horrible. Told us a certain time frame to have the car done a day before they hadn’t even touched the vehicle. Quoted us a price and said once it gets torn down it may go up from there. Called them they said it was 600 more than originally quoted but hadn’t even touched the vehicle. Tried to charge us for parts ordered when they hadn’t touched the vehicle. Randy and his wife were both rude and unprofessional. I told them i had small children I needed to get back and forth to school and the reason I took it to them was because they told me a week and a half. The wife responded with that’s not my problem.tried to pick up the vehicle to take to another shop and they wouldn’t release until we paid for parts. SAVE YOURSELF TIME AND MONEY DO NOT GO TO THEM!!! Not only did they waste over a week of my time they were so rude to me to the point I was crying. Horrible people and horrible way of doing business if I could leave 0 stars I would!!!

reviews.author: Christine Frenzel
reviews.text: I take all of my vehicles to RJ Automotive! I trust that they are doing a great job while also keeping my best interests in mind. They are very informative and they take the time to go over costs and options with me. Randy and Jennifer are the best! I highly recommend RJ Automotive!

reviews.author: Darron Davis
reviews.text: Randy does maintenance and repairs on mine and all my families vehicles. He as always been upfront and honest, and his prices are probably the best in town. I highly recommend him and his staff for all your vehicle needs.

reviews.author: Jennifer Johnson
reviews.text: We took our sons jeep over there for transmission rebuild.. paid about $3200.. still isn’t right.. I wouldn’t recommend this place if it was last place in burlington.. yea it might under warranty but we shouldn’t keep going back and forth. My son has had trouble with the vehicle ever since he got it back from them.. had it over a month.. so tomorrow am filing a with BBB and talking with a lawyer.. he alt to give us our money back if he don’t know what his doing.. now u my son the way u did today on 10/15 lied to him then hang up on him.. really good church folks here at Rj.. nothing but a bunches of crooks.. so got the complaint with BBB now lawyer time.. over the money deal..

reviews.author: Rebecca Seiler
reviews.text: RJ Automotive does great work! Randy and his wife plus the crew do an sensational job at taking care of both my husband's and I vehicles. Whether it's engine repair, oil changes, diesel work, or modifications. You name it they do it! Service is always great and friendly. Love supporting this family owned and operated business. SUPPORT LOCAL!

reviews.author: Jacob Epperson
reviews.text: RJ automotive was highly recommended to me several years ago when I needed some work done on my vehicles. I have not been to another repair shop since then. They offer a wide array of services and have always been up front and honest with me with the diagnosis, which says a lot in this day and time. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Joshua Austin
reviews.text: This is the best shop around hands down. I took my Jeep Wrangler there today to just get an oil change, they were very nice and friendly and it felt like family. They let me know of a few other potential problems I was unaware of on the steering and suspension sent me pictures of repairs and was very reasonably priced. I will recommend this shop to anyone around. Thank you Randy David and Bradley for working So hard to take care of me. Thank y’all again!!

reviews.author: Void
reviews.text: I scheduled an appointment for an oil change, arrived on time, and was told they couldn’t do it. The price they quoted me was also significantly higher than expected. Overall, it felt unprofessional, and I didn’t feel like I was treated fairly. Would not recommend.

reviews.author: Melissa Cook
reviews.text: I was about to report my car as a lemon before Randy finally figured out what was wrong with it. Due to two bad mechanics in the past, I’d put 3 wheel bearings on one side of my car in 3 year (for reference, these should last 80,000-100,000 miles). Randy not only fixed it, he figured out why it was happening (non-replacement of a simple piece that cost almost nothing) he fixed it for almost half what I’d been paying. Now I get quotes before jobs, and Randy’s are always way less. He’s a great guy and a fantastic mechanic!

reviews.author: Courtney Saul
reviews.text: The check engine light on my 2015 Grand Cherokee has come on twice in the past year. Both times, I took it to RJ Automotive and Randy had the problem diagnosed in 1-2 hours and I was back on the road in less than 24 hours. He's an honest mechanic and prices are VERY reasonable. I've searched high and low for a mechanic that I was comfortable with (this is coming form the daughter of a mechanic). Randy will be the only person touching my vehicles in the future.

reviews.author: Barbara Seibold
reviews.text: RJ Automotive has worked on both cars in my household and done a fabulous job. Randy is extremely knowledgeable and hard working. His prices are more than fair and he has the old fashioned work ethic of making sure a job is done right. I highly recommend RJ Automotive.

reviews.author: Rack It Back Armory Gunsmithing
reviews.text: Excellent customer service. Super friendly people. Work truck's entire rear differential decided to launch itself into low earth orbit. RJ turned an otherwise terrible situation into a great experience. It was done quickly, for a good price, and the truck has never driven better. Earned a lifelong customer, and exclusive dealings with my business and employees.

reviews.author: Tina Hamlett
reviews.text: Two weeks ago I went in and spoke with two ladies at the desk about getting a quote to have a transmission put in my van. I let them know how very very important it was for me to have this van working as my mom is disabled and has to have this particular van to go anywhere. I have called numerous times over the last two weeks. The last time I called was about three days ago and they told me Randy would be there in a half an hour and then he would get back to me that day. I have still not heard from them. This place was highly recommended to me. I decided to go somewhere else. I’m really not sure if they’re ever going to call me back.

reviews.author: Mich Faulkner
reviews.text: RJ Automotive is one of a kind when it comes to your car needs. The staff is very accommodating, trustworthy and goes beyond the call of duty when it comes to your car. The best thing is RJ Automative can service all types of cars at an affordable rate.

reviews.author: KBowen
reviews.text: The employees treat you like family and don’t try to rip you off like most places. There is little to no wait time and their work is completed in a timely manner. Also, they don’t charge an arm and a leg like most places which is nice since everything else seems so expensive. Give RJ Automotive a try and you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Kody Matherly
reviews.text: We had to have my son's 4Runner towed in. We thought it was the started. The crew here went thru it and found it was an electrical issue and not the started. They saved us $200 and we are so grateful!! Honesty in your auto mechanic is a huge blessing!!! We would definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Nathaniel Johnson
reviews.text: I took my F250 in and received a answer during a 5 min ride around the block. I was hearing and feeling vibration in my cab. They stated my u-joints were bad. And if i bring it in he would inspect everything closer. I Scheduled an appointment, dropped it off, and they looked it over. By noon i got a call with a solution(replace U-Joints) and by 3pm I was paying and driving away. Great family run business. Appreciate your service and will return when need and high recommend. Thank again

reviews.author: Jabari Rogers
reviews.text: This shop is honest, hardworking and dependable. I’ve taken my vehicles to a handful of shops in Burlington and RJ Automotive is the best one hands down. Randy, Jenn, and Chris understand real customer service.

reviews.author: Jason Warren
reviews.text: RJ Automotive has been my recommendation for numerous clients looking for honest, dependable, and quality workmanship! They have never let me or my cliental down when called upon. A++ for them and all the employees!

reviews.author: Leesa Payne
reviews.text: They did a great job with a clutch issue on an older Honda Accord! They were helpful in the process and great to work with!

reviews.author: Charles Siegenthaler
reviews.text: Have been dealing with RJ Automotive for over 5years nothing but fare prices and honest hard work always up front with all information on any changes. Randy and Jennifer are straight up honest people have done a lot of trouble shooting on my truck and found the problem and made awesome repairs.

reviews.author: Courtney Thomas
reviews.text: I needed someone to repair my transmission. Within a week and a half of me dropping off my car they had my car fixed and ready to go after being without for nearly 10 months great response from Randy and customer service highly recommend.

reviews.author: Terry Ward
reviews.text: They were courteous and helpful the minute I walked in their door. They diagnosed the problems with my vehicle, told me when it would be ready, and gave me the cost up front, which was reasonable. They did what they promised and then some. I would highly recommend RJ Automotive and will be taking all of my vehicles to them in the future.

reviews.author: Chris Crain
reviews.text: These folks took care of my vehicle in a very timely manner and communicated with me each step of the way! I highly recommend RJ Automotive for all your auto repair needs!

reviews.author: Farmer Luke
reviews.text: Great people. Excellent quality work in a reasonable amount of time. Randy and his crew communicate repair needs well and are honest with customers. That's somthj f that is hard to find in this day and time! Thank you for your excellent service.

reviews.author: Monte Marcum
reviews.text: Incredible customer service for a small business - we needed to get a service vehicle out of their shop to make a holiday weekend job and Jen made it happen while out of town so we could service our customers. They get what it means for small business to stick together. It spoke volumes for service and honesty.

reviews.author: Gary Williams
reviews.text: I take all my vehicles to R J Automotive. They are fair and honest!! I get treated like family every time I’m there. The work is completed in a timely manner and for a fair price. I would highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Jeff Van Pelt
reviews.text: Randy, Chris and Jennifer were extremely polite. I received a diagnosis in a timely manner. I would and will recommend RJ Automotive to all of my peers with mechanical issues!! Great job guys!!

reviews.author: Joseph Edwards
reviews.text: RJ Automotive has been doing my vehicles for years and they good prices and get to my vehicles in a good timely manner. I will only use them to work on my vehicles. Because of that and I can trust that them to fix them right.

reviews.author: Emily Nance
reviews.text: Randy and his team are absolutely amazing. They have fixed many vehicles for me and in a timely manner as not to leave me stranded. I can’t thank them enough for all their good work!

reviews.author: Ash A
reviews.text: I have been going there since I bought my car about 2 years ago for oil change, and regular maintenance jobs. I am pleased with their service and how they care for my car.

reviews.author: Randall Brown
reviews.text: awesome service , great prices . highly recommended. Randy knows his stuff and his wife is so nice to the customers at checkout... an A+ automotive company. I won't take my car anywhere else

reviews.author: Misty Bumgarner
reviews.text: Great relationship with customers! Will take the time out of their busy schedule to squeeze you in to get you driving safely.

reviews.author: Chase Johnson
reviews.text: I have taken my vehicles to Randy for years. He is honest and does quality work every time. I recommend him to everyone looking for a great mechanic.

reviews.author: Scott Clayton
reviews.text: Randy and his team have always done things the right way for my vehicles. Fair pricing and prompt service.

reviews.author: Jamaal Johnson
reviews.text: They took care of my vehicle in just 24 hrs and my vehicle is running amazing. The entire crew is respectful & helpful. I highly recommend !!!!!!

reviews.author: Anthony Petty
reviews.text: Great service. Had to have my 2014 dodge avenger’s new tires mounted and balanced. Shop owner was very kind and courteous, employees were timely, and overall experience was excellent.

reviews.author: joseph rudd
reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff, reasonable prices, quick responses and gets your vehicle back on the road quickly. Keep up the hard work Randy

reviews.author: Brad Martin
reviews.text: RJ Automotive is a great place for car maintenance. Folks there are very friendly, and the service is great! I highly recommend anyone to this business to fix or maintain thier vehicle.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: This shop is great and always took great care of me the staff have always helped me get my car fixed and would recommend them to everyone. They have always got my car done in a timely matter and with great pricing

reviews.author: joe taylor
reviews.text: My motorhome broke down on I-40, was pulled into his shop. They jumped on it and found my computer was bad. Spent time on the phone trying to find the right part, couldn't do it so I unhooked my jeep and went home. He kept me updated and finally had to send my PCM to get it repaired. I'll be picking my M/H up tomorrow morning. Randy went beyond 100% to get me going. Thanks.

reviews.author: David Wilson
reviews.text: The people are very nice and didn't try to give me something I didn't need . They try to find the best deal for you on parts and the quality is great as well . I will take all my vehicles here . Thanks for the excellent service.

reviews.author: David Lee
reviews.text: I have been a customer of Randy's for many years now, and I will always take my vehicle to him before anyone. The business is reliable and dependable and I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Ryan Long
reviews.text: Randy & his team took care of replacing my transmission quickly & was very helpful. Highly recommend RJ automotive!

reviews.author: S& DM
reviews.text: I’m from out of town working and when I notice my 2015 F250 dripping coolant. The primary water pump was leaking and RJ replace it with a new one and got me back on the road. Thanks RJ Automotive!! I’ll be sure to stop back in when I’m close to Burlington to get an oil change. RJ and Jen thank you for everything.

reviews.author: Clovis Tyndall
reviews.text: Fast, friendly and nice shop. I am a small business owner and don't have time to sit around. The team at RJ automotive got me in and out in quickly. Will be back and recommend to others

reviews.author: Leshaunda Bellamy
reviews.text: Most trusted, reliable, honest, and caring people I know. They really are like family! Haven’t been to another mechanic since!

reviews.author: Tonya McDonald
reviews.text: Everyone is so very nice and helpful!! Nice to find a shop that I can come to and not feel taken advantage of!! I would definitely recommend anyone to come and get their vehicle serviced here!!

reviews.author: Linda Siegenthaler
reviews.text: Randy and Jennifer have the best interests of the customer. Have worked on all of our cars and trucks been nothing but honest and fair.

reviews.author: Colton P
reviews.text: Awesome! They took me in very last minute and put in a new radiator for me. I’m very pleased and everyone there was knowledgeable and nice.

reviews.author: Wyatt Neel
reviews.text: They installed brand new crank sensor and had it finished in no time.Now my car runs like it should 5/5 stars.

reviews.author: Laura Neel
reviews.text: Services: Vehicle Inspection, Brakes, Auto emissions testing, Auto maintenance, Oil change. Wonderful customer service. I highly recommend you take your vehicles to them

reviews.author: Cathy Meyer
reviews.text: This place is the only place I will bring my Highlander. The staff is very nice and the price is one of the best around town. The work is also done fast so not a long waiting time!! I will be back soon

reviews.author: Jerry Williams
reviews.text: They not only work on vehicles, they were able to rebuilt the front end on my tractor. They were always pleasant to deal with.

reviews.author: Derek Williams
reviews.text: Randy has a great business! He has always taken care of me and my family! I always tell people Randy is the man!

reviews.author: Lindsey Cunnane
reviews.text: Quality work and quality people!! They do a great job and are super helpful and kind. I would recommend this business to everyone for any auto work!

reviews.author: David Bean
reviews.text: Bought my truck in for a post market inspection. Good prices, explained everything, love the work they did.

reviews.author: stephen aspiazu
reviews.text: Randy, his Family, and staff treat me like Family. RJ Automotive is the only place to go for repairs, in my humble opinion.

reviews.author: Linda Staskowicz
reviews.text: So rude and unprofessional. I have never experienced such bad customer service to the point I took my vehicle to a different shop. Please do yourself a favor and stay away.

reviews.author: mcpherson brown
reviews.text: Awesome experience at RJ automotive. Completely rebuilt my transmission. It now shift better then new.

reviews.author: Graham Culbertson
reviews.text: We brought our car in and Randy and his team diagnosed the problem and had the parts ordered and fixed in less than 48 hours!

reviews.author: Eric Walker
reviews.text: Fast and Awesome work. They treated me like family. Best of all the work was done in the time I was told. And I'm truly grateful for that.

reviews.author: IamCountry Strong
reviews.text: Great service and communicated every issue that arose when fixing my vehicle. I would highly recommend this shop.

reviews.author: Hunter Duff
reviews.text: Great shop and people that will make you feel like they truly want to help you. I would take my vehicle back in an instant should the need arise.

reviews.author: Justin TotalTransmissions.com
reviews.text: This is the only place to get your vehicle serviced. Randy and his staff are top notch and only use the best parts available.

reviews.author: William Hinely
reviews.text: Knowledgeable and friendly. They do what they say they’re going to do and that’s big for a mechanic shop. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Kevin Rigsbee
reviews.text: RJ Automotive was very responsive. They quoted me a month ago to install new UCA's and adjustable coil overs for my 2019 Tundra (I had already purchased). My truck already had a spacor lift on top of the stock TRD coilovers. Randy touched base with me to ensure that I wanted the new adjustable coilovers to the exact hight of the previous ones (Communication & Customer Service!) They did a wonderful job on the installation, and alignment I also added an inspection since I was due. My truck rides better than new now. RJ Automotive still has those old school, family centric vibes that this world needs more of these days. I highly recommend them if you are in need of a trustworthy and honest mechanic that does great work at a fair price!
